name: BA Steel LLC
old_description: A family owned and operated metals company with a passion for professional service and quality craftsmanship. BA Steel specializes in providing innovative solutions and high-quality custom metal fabrication for a variety of metal products. Located in Baltimore, for the past 40 years we have continued to service local, state, and federal government agencies, commercial  and industrial contractors, as well as commercial and industrial end users in the Mid Atlantic.
about:
BA Steel LLC operates from Baltimore, Maryland, where it was founded in 1986 as Arrow Metal Fabrication and Constructors before adopting its current name. The company remains family-owned and operated, serving the Mid-Atlantic region for nearly four decades.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication and installation, working in aluminum, stainless steel, black iron, and galvanized metals. Its capabilities include bending, sawing, shearing, punching, plate and angle rolling, plasma cutting, and protective coatings such as paint, zinc, and galvanizing. The facility at 4220 Shannon Drive handles structural steel, sheet metal, gates, railings, and stairs, with AWS- and CWI-qualified welders on staff for on-site and shop welding.

Customers range from local, state, and federal government agencies to commercial and industrial contractors, homebuilders, general contractors, and mechanical trade contractors across the Mid-Atlantic. The company emphasizes a customized client experience with seamless communication and budgeting for projects of any size.

Leadership cites its combined 40-plus years of commercial, industrial, and institutional fabrication experience as a key differentiator, allowing the small business to apply methods typical of larger corporations while maintaining personalized service.
